title: S3 Closure & Sokac/Sokac Validity-Confirmation Bundle - machine-readable verdicts
model: models/ouro_rltt_local (Ouro-2.6B-Thinking + RLTT, 48 layers x 4 UT loops, hidden 2048, total_ut_steps=4, early_exit_threshold=1.0)

s3a_design.objective: train injected/internal branches to be outcome-distinct and verifier-useful (targets Wall A); not a text generator, not inference-time steering

never use tap scores as correctness labels
